causes.source_quote: Previous myocardial infarction, organic heart disease, mitral prolapse. PVC's also occur in individuals without heart disease.
causes.value: Previous myocardial infarction, organic heart disease, mitral prolapse. PVC's also occur in individuals without heart disease.

prognosis.source_quote: Depending on cause, PVC's in young individuals and supraventricular extrasystoles are usually harmless with a favourable prognosis; ventricular extrasystoles are more prone to have an organic cause.
prognosis.value: Depending on cause, PVC's in young individuals and supraventricular extrasystoles are usually harmless with a favourable prognosis; ventricular extrasystoles are more prone to have an organic cause.

summary.source_quote: A premature ventricular contraction (PVC) of the heart that is independent of the normal rhythm and arises in response to an impulse in some part of the heart other than the SA node. Supraventricular extrasystoles originate in the atrium or AV node whilst ventricular extrasystoles originate in the ventricular muscle, sometimes in rapid succession.

treatment.source_quote: Catheter ablation, β-blockers, nondihydropyridine calcium channel blocker, antiarrhythmic drugs.
treatment.value: Catheter ablation, β-blockers, nondihydropyridine calcium channel blocker, antiarrhythmic drugs.
